dct_creator_sm: Edmonton Japanese Community Association History Committee.
dct_description_sm:
A collection of personal histories of Edmonton-area people with Japanese heritage (e.g. Japanese-Canadian, Japanese citizens who have spent time in Edmonton area). These are based on
responses to the the 2013 EJCA community survey and augmented with information collected later.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Individual Histories of Edmonton-area People with Japanese Heritage (2013-2015)
